description: Progressive simulation: festival organisation exploring youth participation

turns.result: Pilot completed. Five young people co-designed a guided night walk combining local nature and storytelling.
turns.observation: Young people were highly engaged when they had creative control. The proposed evening time worked well. Three participants said they would return for the festival.

turns.result: Ran a follow-up co-design session with eight young people.
turns.observation: The group wanted to lead the activity themselves rather than assist adults. They proposed a storytelling route using local landmarks. Two wanted to be paid guides.
